name: install-paths
description: Install in one command — pnpm link and git main, proven

spec.why: Installation is the first touch. Today it takes a clone, a launcher symlink, and faith. Two paths must be true and documented: a dev link in one command (pnpm link) and a global install straight from the git main branch — both verified on the Node floor the docs claim.

requirements.text: The cli bin points at compiled dist (dist/src/main.js — shebang included by tsc); the bin runs on Node 22 and 24 (proven on both present on this machine); the checked-in launcher bin/treadle.mjs retires.

Dev link: from a fresh clone — pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm link --global (from packages/cli, or one documented chain); the linked treadle passes --help + do where + a know command from an arbitrary directory.

Git install: the repo root package.json (private, workspaces:["treadle"], bin → cli dist, prepare building the workspace) makes `npm i -g --allow-scripts=<name> <git-url>#main` deliver a working treadle; the flag is documented as npm security default, not an obstacle.
Clean-room verification: every documented path proves itself in a fresh temp clone on BOTH node floors (22.14, 24.19 present locally); a windows note records the CI-matrix check.
The pnpm git-workspace syntax is recorded broken (observed crash) unless a clean-room test passes in-wave; the guide names npm for git installs, pnpm for the dev link.
Guide section 03 + README rewritten to the two one-command paths; the launcher-symlink dance removed; install verified literally (AC-3).
Gates stay green: pnpm check, corpus byte-stable, brand clean (the root package.json rides the fence allowances like ci.yml), links green.
The wave closes through its own loop: evidence rows, review rounds, frozen by human:owner.

clarifications.question: The git-install target: the whole repository (root package.json orchestrating treadle/ via prepare, npm --allow-scripts documented) or the future engram-dev shape where the workspace IS the repo root (cleanest, no orchestration layer)?
Node floor: the guide says 22+ — hold that floor (bin must point at compiled dist, proven working on 22.14) or raise the docs to 24 (native TS lets the source bin run)?

out_of_scope: registry publish (npm publish of one bundled package) — the successor that retires the whole question
the engram-dev code split (Q-1 names the shape; the bin and clean-room verifications carry over)

stories.title: One-command dev link
stories.as: a contributor on a fresh clone
stories.want: pnpm link in one command, no hand-made symlinks
stories.so: the first touch installs in seconds

acceptance.then: treadle --help and treadle do where work from any directory; no launcher file is involved

stories.title: Install from main
stories.as: a user with the repo URL
stories.want: a global install straight from the git main branch
stories.so: no clone, no build, no faith

acceptance.then: treadle works from any directory; the security flag is named and explained in the same breath
every one works as written — the clean-room proof is the evidence

decisions.decision: bin → compiled dist; the Node floor is 22 (Q-2 default)
decisions.because: Proven: node 22.14 refuses the .ts bin (ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION); the dist bin ran green on 22 and 24. The floor the docs already claim becomes real.

decisions.decision: Root orchestrator for the git install; npm with --allow-scripts documented (Q-1 default)
decisions.because: Proven: npm skips prepare by default (allow-scripts); the orchestrator must declare the bin itself. pnpm #workspace syntax crashed (observed).

decisions.decision: Clean-room proof or it is not documented
decisions.because: The guide teaches commands; every command must have run literally in a fresh clone on both node floors before it is printed.

tasks.title: The bin contract: dist + the Node floor
tasks.detail: packages/cli bin → ./dist/src/main.js; pnpm build verified as prerequisite; bin/treadle.mjs retired; the local PATH symlink refreshed; treadle proven on Node 22 AND 24 (both present).

verify.cmd: cd treadle && pnpm build && /usr/local/bin/node packages/cli/dist/src/main.js --help && node packages/cli/dist/src/main.ts --help 2>/dev/null || true
verify.expect: dist bin speaks usage under node 22 explicitly; the launcher file no longer exists

tasks.title: The dev link, one command
tasks.detail: From a FRESH temp clone (not this tree): corepack enable, pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm link --global (from packages/cli); then from /tmp: treadle --help, do where, know validate — all exit 0. Record the exact command chain the guide will teach.

verify.cmd: clean-room script: temp clone → link chain → /tmp assertions
verify.expect: all commands green from an arbitrary directory on a fresh clone; no launcher file touched

tasks.title: The git install from main
tasks.detail: Repo-root package.json (private, workspaces:["treadle"], bin → treadle/packages/cli/dist/src/main.js, prepare: corepack+install+build); clean-room: git clone file:// → npm i -g --allow-scripts=<name> <clone> → treadle from /tmp on both node floors; pnpm git path retested once, recorded working or broken.

verify.cmd: clean-room script: bare-clone → npm i -g --allow-scripts → /tmp assertions
verify.expect: treadle delivered and working; the allow-scripts flag documented in the same command

tasks.title: Docs tell the truth
tasks.detail: Guide section 03 rewritten (two one-command paths, node floor stated, the flag explained, launcher dance gone, troubleshooting row for allow-scripts); README install block matches; every documented command run literally as the evidence.

verify.cmd: the documented commands, run literally from the guide text
verify.expect: each command works as written — the literal run is the evidence

tasks.title: Close: evidence, review round, freeze
tasks.detail: Every task evidence-rows machine-checked; one review round minimum; gates green (check, corpus, brand incl. the new root package.json, links); frozen by human:owner.

verify.expect: gates green; rounds recorded; closed by owner
